info.title: Saving crash dumps to a remote target

abstract.para: By default, &kdump; saves crash dumps locally under /var/crash. On systems with limited local storage, or where dumps must be collected centrally, configure KDUMP_SAVEDIR to save dumps to a remote target instead.

section.title: Supported remote storage protocols
section.para: KDUMP_SAVEDIR in /etc/sysconfig/kdump accepts a URL in the form PROTOCOL://SPECIFICATION. Install the client package matching the protocol you plan to use:

listitem.para: openssh-clients, for ssh:// and sftp:// targets.

section.title: Saving dumps over SSH
section.para: A crash dump can contain sensitive data from system memory. SSH keeps that data encrypted in transit. SFTP is the preferred transport, since it does not require the target host to run any special server-side commands beyond the SFTP subsystem, which is enabled by default on &productnameshort;.
